content:
4c27da763 (HEAD -> main) [CBDT] Fix more offsetting
0f85edb77 [morx] Another end-of-text corner case
55d5ea666 [kerx] Merge clusters in Ligature
bb35725cd [kerx/morx] More end-of-text protection
8f3048a1f [dump-emoji] minor

---STATUS---

---BUILD---
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fno-sanitize=function,vptr"
export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -fno-sanitize=function,vptr"
./autogen.sh
./configure
make clean
make -j$(nproc) V=1 all
make CPPFLAGS="-DHB_NO_VISIBILITY" -C src V=1 fuzzing
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Isrc     ./test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/hb-shape-fuzzer     -lFuzzingEngine ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-fuzzing.a
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Isrc     ./test/fuzzing/hb-subset-fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/hb-subset-fuzzer     -lFuzzingEngine ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-subset-fuzzing.a ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-fuzzing.a
zip -j -r $OUT/hb-shape-fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/harfbuzz/test/shaping/data/in-house/fonts $SRC/harfbuzz/test/shaping/data/text-rendering-tests/fonts $SRC/harfbuzz/test/api/fonts
cp $OUT/hb-shape-fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $OUT/hb-subset-fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip
